export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await (
					operation as { await: (item: unknown) => Promise<unknown> }
				).await(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
